old = '''def iter_lines(stream):
    """Yield each line (newline stripped); yields None for overlong lines."""
    buf = bytearray()
    pending = False
    overlong = False
    while True:
        chunk = stream.read(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        pos = 0
        n = len(chunk)
        while pos < n:
            i = chunk.find(b"\\n", pos)
            if i < 0:
                buf.extend(chunk[pos:])
                if not overlong and len(buf) > MAX_LINE:
                    overlong = True
                    del buf[:]
                pending = True
                pos = n
                break
            buf.extend(chunk[pos:i + 1])
            pending = True
            pos = i + 1
            if overlong or len(buf) > MAX_LINE:
                yield None
            else:
                yield bytes(buf[:-1])
            del buf[:]
            pending = False
            overlong = False
    if pending:
        if overlong:
            yield None
        else:
            yield bytes(buf)'''
new = '''def iter_lines(stream):
    """Yield each line (newline stripped); yields None for overlong lines.

    Reads use a single raw read per call (never blocking to fill a buffer),
    so the controller can send one line and wait for its response.
    """
    reader = stream.read1 if hasattr(stream, "read1") else stream.read
    buf = bytearray()
    pending = False
    overlong = False
    while True:
        chunk = reader(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        pos = 0
        n = len(chunk)
        while pos < n:
            i = chunk.find(b"\\n", pos)
            if i < 0:
                buf.extend(chunk[pos:])
                if len(buf) > MAX_LINE:
                    # do not retain an overlong line in memory
                    overlong = True
                    del buf[:]
                pending = True
                pos = n
                break
            buf.extend(chunk[pos:i + 1])
            pending = True
            pos = i + 1
            if overlong or len(buf) > MAX_LINE:
                yield None
            else:
                yield bytes(buf[:-1])
            del buf[:]
            pending = False
            overlong = False
    if pending:
        if overlong:
            yield None
        else:
            yield bytes(buf)'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('/app/submission/planner.py','w').write(src)

EOF
